summary: PayVerify Bot iteration 2 — all four new features (Duplicate UTR Guard, Daily Digest via Resend, Cron endpoint w/ HMAC auth+idempotency, responsive header) plus regression pass are fully green. 16/16 backend pytest cases pass and 8/8 Playwright frontend checks pass. Duplicate flow correctly persists, skips GPay, substitutes {utr_last4}/{orig_sender}/{orig_time} in the reply, and shows up in stats + filtered list with violet badge. Manual digest via delivered@resend.dev returned sent:true with a real email_id and appeared in /api/digest/history. Cron endpoint returns 401 without/with wrong bearer, 200 with correct WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET, is idempotent on X-Webhook-Id, and acks in well under 2s (background _send_daily_digest is spawned via asyncio.create_task). Mobile 390px header has no horizontal overflow (bodyScroll==docWidth==390) and nav collapses to icons.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `import asyncio` is done inside cron_digest handler — cheap but move to module top for style.
email_service.py `_assert_safe_email` is solid but consider caching parsed HTMLParser results; not a blocker.

bot_orchestrator._find_duplicate treats an earlier row with status='duplicate' as a duplicate match too — behaves correctly because it links to the earliest row, but consider narrowing the $in filter to only ['received','not_received'] so the duplicate_of always points to the root submission rather than potentially the previous duplicate row (currently sort by created_at ASC saves this in practice).
test_credentials: N/A — no auth; WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET is read from /app/backend/.env by tests.
seed_data_creation: Duplicate flow test creates 2 transactions with a time-derived UTR ending in an even digit; digest test toggles settings owner_email=delivered@resend.dev and digest_enabled=true and leaves them set (per playbook, delivered@resend.dev is the intended sandbox recipient).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 is fully green. Backend covered by /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_2.py (pytest-xdist 2 workers, ~12s). Live WhatsApp watcher was intentionally NOT tested (BOT_MOCK_MODE=true). Note: settings were left with owner_email=delivered@resend.dev and digest_enabled=true after the run so a subsequent /api/digest/send-now will still send. If future tests need a clean state, reset via PUT /api/settings.
